scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:worker
scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && find functions -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.deploy:pages: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name pk-laser-os --config wrangler.pages.toml
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
